title: Verify data lineage can be traced from source to final report
gherkin:
Feature: Data Lineage Traceability
  Scenario: Trace data lineage from source to final report
    Given a data source with initial records
    When data is processed through multiple transformation steps
    And the final report is generated
    Then the complete lineage path from source to report is traceable
    And each transformation step is recorded in the lineage
rationale: Core requirement to ensure data lineage can be tracked end-to-end from original source through all transformations to the final report output.
generationSummary: Test cases for reporting data lineage traceability functionality, covering the ability to track and report the origin, transformations, and flow of data through a system.

title: Verify lineage information is accessible in reports
gherkin:
Feature: Data Lineage Reporting
  Scenario: Access lineage information from generated report
    Given a report has been generated from processed data
    When a user requests lineage information for the report
    Then the lineage details are displayed
    And the lineage includes source data references
    And the lineage includes all intermediate transformations
rationale: Users must be able to access and view the data lineage information directly from reports to understand data provenance.
generationSummary: Test cases for reporting data lineage traceability functionality, covering the ability to track and report the origin, transformations, and flow of data through a system.

title: Verify lineage tracks data transformations

Feature: Transformation Tracking

    Given data undergoes filtering transformations
    And data undergoes aggregation transformations
    And data undergoes calculation transformations
    When the lineage is generated
    Then each transformation type is recorded
    And the sequence of transformations is preserved
    And transformation parameters are captured
rationale: Data lineage must capture all types of transformations applied to data to provide complete traceability.
